PURPOSE: Machine authentication for the trust-kernel: workload identity (non-human client identity with hash-stored secret), session/token lifecycle (short-lived scoped bearer JWTs + opaque revocable sessions, two-phase secret rotation), and auth boundaries (broker-issued credentials, resource-side validation via JWKS or server call, session-scoped revocation).
